posts.author: _Liberty_Prime_
posts.title: Kek!

posts.raw_content:
For a time, I believed that boomers had found this site and simply failed to grasp the Gen X/Millennial/Gen Z humor that used to happen here. 

But over the past year or so, I've been noticing a trend where commenters don't even realize a joke is being told or that some image is a meme. For all the Boomer's are out of touch, they at least have their own humor and can recognize jokes when they see them. Even if they misinterpret them. 

Today we have a stickied meme. It's not mine but I like it. It's classic The_Donald. Something straight out of 2016. It's a silly little meme about Pepe memes being presented in a boardroom. The humor, and I hate having to explain this, comes from the fact that since 2016, those of us who have been around from the beginning are still amazed that we basically memed a reality show star into the presidency and spat in the eye of the demonic homosexual pedophile infrastructure that runs the entire world. And we did it with pictures of a cartoon frog and jokes about centipedes. 

The juvenile and innocent overcoming the powerful evil is hilarious. 

And boomers understand that. They understand why that's funny. It's minions and Charlie Brown for them, rather than Pepe and Awoooo. And their memes are more obvious and on the nose. But they understand the concept. 

But it occurred to me today that the literal retards in the third world DON'T. They don't understand why that's funny. They don't understand why most things are funny. They're not smart enough for humor. At least anything that isn't basically "ow my balls." 

It's pretty obvious that we've been being brigaded by these assholes for a while. They can't make their own things, so they come here to steal ours. Same story we're seeing in real life with immigration. But I think there's something more pernicious going on. As the third-worlding of the internet progresses, our young people are operating more and more in retard dominated spaces. I think that as they encounter these humorless NPCs more than they encounter people with a fully realized human soul, they are themselves losing their ability to recognize humor, much less create it. 

And that's a real problem. Humor is our only real weapon against the faggots who run the world. That's a big part of why the third world perpetually sucks ass. They lack the intelligence and culture to employ that weapon. 

Luther said that "the Devil can not bear scorn." Chesterton said that angels "can fly because they take themselves lightly." 

That brings me to my final conclusion. In addition to intelligence, the reason we can employ humor so effectively is because our ancestors were smart enough to build a guilt-innocence society. We can even make fun of ourselves because we know we are innocent and our foes are guilty as fuck. But we are being replaced - physically through immigration, but also intellectually through brigading - by an honor-shame culture. This is a culture which is not concerned with what is actually right or wrong. It is a culture which is concerned with how it looks to others. 

This is the core reason, even more fundamental than intelligence, though intelligence is how they got there, why they can't understand jokes. There is no core truth in their worldview which can be looked at from different angles. You can't make fun of yourself in their worldview, because the perception is the reality. And as the internet becomes increasingly third world, it's going to further influence our young people. 

I don't have a good way to wrap this up. Thanks for reading. If you're a parent or a mentor of some kind, teach the kids to be funny. Teach them to not be so serious all the time. If you're not one of those things, become one of those things. We need all hands on deck.
